main_text.head: OTHONIS CASMANNI NVCLEI PHYSICI LIBER SECVNDVS.
CAPUT PRIMVM. DE ΟΥΡΑΝΟΓΡΑΦΙΑ SEU DE COELO.
main_text.p: Hactenus exposita est Physicæ pars prior, in communibus principiis & affectionibus: Se-quitur pars altera quæ PRO-PRIA dicitur, quippe quæ propria singulorum corporum naturalium natura scru-tatur & distincte explicat.
Universum corporum naturalium ordinatum Systema dicitur MUNDUS,Mundus, qui est, Aristoteli, compages constans è Cœlo & Terra, & Naturis, quæ in eis continentur.
Hinc distinctio corporum mundanorum est in Continentia & Contenta: Eaq. Scriptu-ris non ignota, quæ mundum seu corpora omnia complectitur Cælo & Terra, & omnibus quæ sunt

page.notes: The catchword "sunt" is printed at the lower right, under the last line, and is kept out of the text. The Greek title ΟΥΡΑΝΟΓΡΑΦΙΑ is printed with a small "DE" above it; the "Hactenus" drop cap is a woodcut initial H, joined to the word. The italic/roman division of the last three lines is hard to see on the scan and may be wrong in places. A faint signature at the very bottom edge is not legible and is left out. Show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.
